decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an abrupt multi-sample drop near index 620–624 into a sustained low platform, suggesting a possible jump or rapid transient; (2) the final window (725–729) shows a sharp reversal from extreme values, possibly a return or new offset. Both involve ambiguous boundaries and superposed changes; no other windows show similarly distinct cross-axis morphology.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in N/E/U (especially N and U) around index 620–624, followed by a sustained platform at large negative offsets; the drop appears abrupt and not fully resolved in coarse view—possible permanent offset or rapid transient with ambiguous return.

After a long period of large-amplitude motion, indices 725–729 show a sudden shift toward less extreme values in all axes, possibly indicating recovery or new regime; the change is abrupt over 5 samples and contrasts with prior trend—warrants closer inspection for opposing return or step change.
